visualAcceptance.routeReadability: accepted for the complete single-source map; the current courtyard-to-Siloam route remains continuous while the full painted context stays visible
visualAcceptance.actorAndDoorScale: accepted for centralized 128-132 px target display heights, including the native 200 px Jesus directional frames
visualAcceptance.identityContinuity: accepted for private preview; pinned Jesus clothing and face vocabulary retained
visualAcceptance.poseAndStateClarity: accepted for blind, clay-applied, seeing, worship, clay-action, found-man, neighbor, inquiry, and parent states used by John 9:1-41
visualAcceptance.theologicalRestraint: accepted; no halo, glow, beam, fantasy particles or theatrical miracle effect

limitations: The generated world is a stylized neutral gameplay composition, not a historical reconstruction.
The runtime world retains the selected source image in full through one proportional resize; no crop compositing or neutral-fill patching is used.
The world base is a single painted two-dimensional composition aligned to canonical anchors; collision and navigation remain canonical metadata rather than pixel-derived geometry.
The pinned Jesus vendor sheet provides four-direction idle and two-step walk frames through deterministic byte-copy extraction.

Observer walk frames, full man-born-blind directional animation, and supporting-actor up/down or walk frames remain blocked because the built-in image-generation tool is unavailable; restored formal static poses and current directional/look-right assets are used without CLI fallback or substitute art.
Dialogue portraits were not generated because the current UI has no portrait surface.
All generated and pinned packs remain non-release-eligible until rights and public redistribution review.
